model.name: CalendarEntry is a natural CLASS (UnitConvertible + MVC-renders-itself) — a dropped calendar-entry instantiates the CalendarEntry object
model.description: CalendarEntry is a CLASS implementing UnitConvertible {isBinary/load/toUnit/fromUnit}; MimeType.from resolves a calendar-entry drop (.ics/text-calendar) to the CalendarEntry class (NO content-type string-switch outside MimeType). A dropped calendar entry RESOLVES to a CalendarEntry scenario unit that is INSTANTIATED; the CalendarEntry object owns model+view+controller and RENDERS ITSELF (detail + date fields) — not bytes-stored, not a handler branch. Specific CalendarEntry behaviour that extends the R40.99 natural-class contract; re-homed from the T40 task (was orphaned hand-written ACs, PO 2026-09-06).
model.crossRefNote: Class-SPECIFIC extension of R40.99 (natural-class UnitConvertible MVC ruling). Gives the CalendarEntry-specific ACs a single-source req home so T40 covers a specific req, not the broad umbrella.
